chapters.title: Where does this figure fit?
chapters.answer: Select Figure 8 in the outline and see the original alongside the reading.

chapters.title: What does this axis mean?
chapters.answer: Open panel A, click the horizontal axis and follow the line to its explanation.

chapters.title: Which panels belong in the talk?
chapters.answer: Collect A and B in the slide basket, add notes and drag them into order.

chapters.title: How do the figures build an argument?
chapters.answer: Open the mind map. Current figure brings the branch for the figure beside it into view.

chapters.title: How do the panels become a slide deck?
chapters.answer: Open Slides and edit the text on the slide. Speaker notes have a separate field.

chapters.title: Need a cue during rehearsal?
chapters.answer: Rehearse, reveal the notes when needed, then export the complete PowerPoint.
